name: excalidraw-room-mcp
description: MCP server that joins a live Excalidraw collaboration room so an AI agent can read and write the drawing

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:view
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:view-test && node --test dist/*.test.js dist/view-test/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npm run build:view-test && mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude="dist/*.test.js" --test-coverage-exclude="dist/view-test/*.test.js" --test-coverage-exclude="dist/e2e.js" --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/lcov.info dist/*.test.js dist/view-test/*.test.js
